comment: The Testville library should open earlier on weekdays.
The Testville library should stay open later on Fridays.
Sunday opening matters more than late weekday opening.
Shorter hours are acceptable if the library adds more staff per shift.
Self-service hours without staff would be a good idea.
Opening hours should be the same every day so they are easy to remember.
The library should publish usage data before changing its hours.
School holidays should have different hours from term time.
